correctness.rationale: Exhaustive enumeration from all 13 size-six open neighborhoods finds exactly 598 faces and face vector (13,78,221,195,78,13). The deterministic thirteen-label toggle matching has 286 disjoint pairs and exactly one critical vertex and 25 critical two-faces. Its fully constructed directed Hasse incidence graph has 2067 edges; an actual topological sort visits all 598 faces, proving acyclicity. Discrete Morse theory yields a CW complex with one vertex and 25 two-cells, hence an integral wedge of 25 two-spheres, with no possible nontrivial attaching maps. An independently built scanner computes mod-p boundaries and the 5-coloring and verifies the independence bound. Executable certificates were run from the included source paths.

value.rationale: Paley(13) is a canonical smallest nontrivial six-regular prime-order conference graph with a toroidal geometric realization of its 1-skeleton. Its Lovász complex is a natural invariant in topological graph coloring. The exact integral homotopy decomposition of a 5-dimensional simplicial complex into 25 two-spheres is structural, not given by face counts or field homology. It also demonstrates a strict one-color gap between ordinary connectivity-based Lovász bound 4 and χ=5. The graph/order is intrinsic and motivated; no claim of a whole-family theorem is needed.
